defects.found_by: C (first real input: B snapshot_00 skeleton)
defects.what: census_qc_c.py counted placeholder tokens as data: evidence_hash 'NOT_OBSERVED' read as an evidence pointer → evidence_adequate 50/50, EVIDENCE_OR_TERMINAL 50/50 on a mart with 0 attempts; B INGEST_STATS said 0 — C was the wrong one
defects.why_controls_missed_it: the synthetic controls never contained placeholder tokens (they used real-looking paths), so 'absent' and 'present' were the only two states exercised — the third state (placeholder) was not in the corpus (R32 three states)
defects.fix: SENTINELS set + _evidence_present (hash regex / existing path only) + attempted_observed from attempt_status; controls added: skeleton_50_placeholders→0/0/0 and token_as_evidence_pointer_not_counted (17 controls)
defects.lesson: a verifier's control corpus must contain the producer's placeholder vocabulary; the first real input is itself a control — read its numbers against the producer's before trusting either
